text: This is a short explainer, made from a script and a kit of paper pieces.
Each spoken line drives the picture, so this number counts as I say it.
Requests flow from the phones, through the edge, to the server. When too many arrive at once, the edge turns some of them away, and the server keeps up.
Before, every moment was typed as a frame number. Now the words set the pace.
Change the script, run one command, and the scene is timed again.
